verdict.rationale: Babylon.js documents TypeScript support with full IntelliSense, which means typed API definitions an editor can attach to for completions. A community user corroborates that the TypeScript integration works well, and the typedoc class reference shows a typed API surface. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of shipped .d.ts definitions and editor diagnostics/navigation behavior, plus detailed setup docs for agent editors beyond a one-line claim.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the scripting language has first-class machine tooling — an official language server (LSP) or typed API definitions a coding agent's editor can attach to for completions, diagnostics, and navigation

citations.quote: The integration with TypeScript works well
